redaction.help.message: Change selected information in the exported copy. The source draft is unchanged. Metric keys change only when you explicitly replace them with aliases.

redaction.mask_caution.message: A replacement host mask is not automatically bound to real hosts. Review it before publishing.

redaction.matching.message: Apply to exact matches in supported names and host masks

redaction.limit.message: Up to 128 objects per copy; if there are more matches, the operation is refused without changes.

redaction.remaining.message: Remaining candidates: {count}. The check is limited and does not guarantee anonymization.

redaction.acknowledge.message: I understand this check is incomplete and I must verify that no credentials are shared.

redaction.failed.message: Could not prepare the copy. Check the replacements and reload a changed draft.

redaction.credentials_block.message: Export is blocked because this limited check found possible credentials. Remove them from the draft and review again.

package_scan.warning.message: This limited local check does not guarantee anonymization or find every sensitive value. Review the contents before sharing.

package_scan.none.message: No candidates found by this limited check.

package_scan.truncated.message: Only the first 256 candidates are shown.

package_scan.failed.message: The check could not be completed.

package_scan.unknown.message: Unknown field or widget; not fully checked

package_scan.unknown_count.message: Unknown fields or widgets: {count}; their content is not fully checked.

package_import.compatibility_range.message: Author-declared compatibility: {minimum} up to, but not including, {maximum}

package_import.registry_known.message: The local 7.4 registry recognizes these widgets and fields for format checks. This does not confirm server support, especially on 8.0.

package_import.registry_unknown.message: The local 7.4 registry cannot assess every widget or field. Server support, including 8.0, is not confirmed.

package_import.registry_incompatible.message: The local registry found no common supported version for these widgets.

package_import.registry_mismatch.message: The author-declared range extends beyond the range inferred from the local registry.

package_import.registry_min.message: Local format estimate: {version} and later; server support is unverified

package_import.registry_range.message: Local format estimate: {minimum} up to, but not including, {maximum}; server support is unverified

package_import.hash_hint.message: Compare this fingerprint with a trusted value. It does not establish who created the file.

package_import.help.message: Select DATA-ONLY ZIP files or YAML files without catalogs. Catalogs are kept inside each imported draft.

package_import.limits.message: Up to 32 files; each ZIP up to 16 MiB, each YAML up to 2 MiB, and the selection up to 32 MiB.

package_import.invalid.message: The package could not be validated.

package_import.failed.message: Import failed. Check the files and try again.

offline_builder.export_failed.message: The page package could not be prepared. The saved page was not changed.

offline_builder.title.message: Create a page from metric catalogs

offline_builder.help.message: Choose catalog versions and metrics, add a graph or item value, then save a local page. Server hosts are assigned later.

offline_builder.error.message: The page operation failed. Check the selected metrics and try again.

offline_builder.catalog_in_use.message: Remove widgets that use this catalog before changing its version or deselecting it.

offline_builder.server_copies_empty.message: No server copies yet. Local pages are listed below.

offline_builder.profile_current.message: Widget evaluation profile for this draft — Zabbix {version}

offline_builder.profile_unavailable.message: No local widget registry is available for the version declared in this draft.

offline_builder.profile_help.message: This profile is used for local widget checks. Publishing requires separate verification on the target server.

offline_builder.add_graph.message: Add graph with selected numeric metrics

offline_builder.add_item.message: Add item value for selected metric

offline_builder.roles_help.message: Slots describe future hosts in their explicit order. Use unique IDs with 2–64 lowercase Latin letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter. Real hosts are assigned later.

offline_builder.role_invalid.message: Check role and slot IDs. IDs must be unique, a single-host role needs exactly one slot, and a multiple-host role needs 1–256 slots.

offline_builder.role_in_use.message: Remove widgets that use this role before removing the role.

offline_builder.slots.message: Slot IDs, one per line, in host order

offline_builder.add_repeat.message: Add item value for each host

offline_builder.logical_help.message: Logical composition only: slots are unbound, layout and target limits must be checked after assigning real hosts.

offline_builder.logical_counts.message: Declared composition: {widgets} widget instances, {sources} metric sources.

offline_builder.graph_rows.message: Logical rows in this graph: {count} (one widget).

offline_builder.logical_truncated.message: The list shows at most 256 instances and 512 metric sources; totals include the entire composition.

offline_builder.slots_missing.message: This earlier page has no explicit logical slots. Edit its role to declare slots before saving changes.

offline_builder.manual_help.message: This form saves manually. Autosave, undo and the visual editor are not available in this implementation yet. Apply each role or widget change before saving the page.

offline_builder.leave_dirty.message: The form has unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?

offline_builder.library_unavailable.message: The library could not be loaded. Saved catalog copies remain available for this page.

offline_builder.conflict.message: Another save changed this page. Your form is preserved; reload the saved version to continue. Changes were not overwritten.

offline_builder.pending_help.message: Apply or cancel the role or widget input before saving the page.

offline_editor.scope.message: Local page editing: history and layout, without server publication or live values.

offline_editor.history_hint.message: Opening loads the last successfully saved version. Undo is available for changes since opening; history is kept only in memory.

offline_editor.history_limit.message: Only the latest 200 steps are available; earlier steps were removed.

offline_editor.autosave_help.message: Applied changes save after 2 seconds of inactivity or after 30 seconds of continuous editing. Unapplied role and widget input stays in the form.

offline_editor.autosave_after_create.message: Autosave starts after the first explicit page save.

offline_editor.retry.message: Not saved. Retrying in {seconds} seconds. The current form is preserved.

offline_editor.canvas_help.message: Select a widget. Arrows move by 1 cell; Shift+arrows by 6; Ctrl+arrows resize. Delete removes a supported widget, Ctrl+D duplicates it. Placement and size also have numeric controls. Zoom changes only the view.

offline_editor.geometry_rejected.message: The widget was not moved: choose whole cells within the grid without overlaps. Repeated widgets keep automatic placement.

offline_editor.repeat_auto.message: Repeated widgets: automatic placement after host binding

offline_editor.opaque.message: Fields are read-only. You can change the layout or remove the entire widget.

offline_editor.confirm_removal.message: Remove these widgets from the draft?

offline_editor.confirm_removal_help.message: You can undo this change from the editor history.

offline_editor.removal_dependency.message: The draft could not be saved because a remaining widget may depend on a removed widget. Undo the removal or remove its dependents together.

offline_editor.open_elsewhere.message: Open for editing in another tab. This tab is read-only; unsaved input remains available for copying.

offline_editor.owner_unavailable.message: Editor ownership could not be confirmed. Saving is stopped until ownership is confirmed.

offline_editor.recovery.message: Recent changes may not have been saved. The last successful version from {time} was loaded.

offline_editor.selection_help.message: Ctrl+click toggles selection; Shift+click selects a range. In the list, Space toggles a widget. Ctrl+A selects all, Esc clears selection. Copy and paste use this application window only.

offline_editor.checks_help.message: These local composition checks also appear on the canvas and widget list. The server validates every save. Publishing requires separate source assignment and verification.

offline_editor.check.bounds.message: Widget geometry must fit the 72 × 64 grid.

offline_editor.check.incomplete.message: The widget has no metric source.

offline_editor.check.catalog.message: Catalog {catalog} is not pinned to this page.

offline_editor.check.metric.message: Metric {metric} is unavailable in the pinned catalog.

offline_editor.check.metric_type.message: The metric type is unsupported by this widget.

offline_editor.check.unrecognized_fields.message: Fields with unknown compatibility: {count}. Their values are preserved.

offline_editor.check.role.message: Check role {role} and its source selector.

offline_editor.check.binding.message: Assign and verify real sources before publishing.

offline_editor.check.mixed_units.message: This graph mixes metric units. Check axis configuration after assigning real sources; publication may be blocked.

offline_editor.clipboard.cut_pending.message: Cut staged for {count} widgets. The source stays unchanged until a successful paste on the same page.

offline_editor.clipboard.copied.message: Copied widgets: {count}. Stored in memory until this window closes.

offline_editor.clipboard.resolve_help.message: Review placement and source compatibility. Pasting is one undoable operation and never moves existing widgets.

offline_editor.clipboard.first_free.message: First free area, keeping relative positions

offline_editor.clipboard.resolve_sources.message: Review explicit source choices below. Exact identities are preselected; different identities require your choice. All choices are rechecked against the current target before insertion.

offline_editor.clipboard.opaque.message: The entire selection was rejected because it includes a preserved widget. Its opaque data stays unchanged.

offline_editor.clipboard.reference.message: Copying widgets with additional fields or references is unsupported. The entire selection was rejected.

offline_editor.clipboard.catalog.message: Choose an existing pinned target catalog for source catalog {value}.

offline_editor.clipboard.role.message: Resolve role {value}: cardinality, slot count and declared order must match.

offline_editor.clipboard.metric.message: Choose a current pinned target metric for {value}, with matching value type and units.

offline_editor.clipboard.geometry.message: The whole group cannot fit without overlaps. Choose another placement or free space.

offline_editor.clipboard.limit.message: Pasting would exceed the page widget limit.

offline_editor.clipboard.source_changed.message: The cut source changed. Select and cut again.

offline_editor.clipboard.cross_page_cut.message: Cutting between pages is not available. Copy instead; the source has not changed.

offline_editor.clipboard.ids.message: Unique widget IDs could not be allocated. Nothing was pasted.

offline_editor.resolve.help.message: Choose existing pinned catalogs, compatible metrics and roles. Only matching value types and units are offered. Choices change only the inserted widgets; target roles and catalogs stay unchanged.

offline_editor.resolve.no_metrics.message: This pinned catalog has no metrics with matching value type and units.

offline_editor.resolve.no_roles.message: No target role has the same cardinality and slot count. Configure the target page before retrying.

offline_editor.resolve.slot_order.message: Map every slot once, preserving declared order. Changing the number or order of repeated sources is not available in this paste.

redaction.unresolved_name.message: Unresolved object name {field} in widget {widget}, page {page}

redaction.save_as_hint.message: Choose a new .zip file. Existing files are not overwritten.

redaction.remove_caution.message: Exclusion is blocked when a remaining widget may lose a provider, or when retained unknown fields prevent a safe check.

redaction.save_no_overwrite.message: Choose a new file; existing files are not overwritten.

redaction.selector_aliases.message: Replace metric keys with aliases in catalog {catalog}

redaction.clear_uuids.message: Remove template and metric UUIDs in catalog {catalog}

redaction.alias_caution.message: Aliases replace metric keys in this copy. Metrics must be matched again before publishing.

export_progress.too_late.message: Saving has already reached the final step and can no longer be cancelled.

package_scan.free_text.message: Name or free text to review

redaction.id_caution.message: Identifiers must use the portable identifier format. Unknown objects block identifier changes.

redaction.protected.message: The change cannot be verified safely: check remaining widget links or unknown fields. Remove or revise the affected objects and preview again.

redaction.item_pattern_caution.message: Changing an item pattern may change which metrics the widget displays. Review the target server before publishing.

redaction.clear_catalog_source_caution.message: The copy will no longer identify the source template or its export version.

redaction.units_caution.message: Changing or clearing units changes metric interpretation and matching. An empty replacement clears the units.
